desc: The Hypa-Lite™ Shocker™ Turkey Gun Sling is a sling designed with turkey hunting in mind. The sling begins with ultra-durable and lightweight hypalon construction with molded, low-density foam and a non-slip backing. The front of the turkey hunting gun sling features Mossy Oak Obsession camo in quiet fabric, plus three mouth call storage pockets with a quiet opening flap, and two extra shotgun shell loops. The body of the shoulder pad is 14? long by 3.25? wide, and the adjustable web sling is 1? wide. Includes an adjustable ladder lock buckle and swivels tested up to 300 pounds.
